Shoot for the moon and you may still be losing.

Kevin Trudeau says people set their targets wrong. They aim so high they never hit them. He compares it to football. When a team is struggling, the quarterback throws a short pass, then another, just to get some momentum.

Kevin says to set your goals so you always hit them ahead of schedule. Aim lower, hit it in the first week, and you get a victory. Momentum comes from a couple of wins.

What target could you set this week that you are certain to beat?

Kevin's network for money and success thinking (GIN) is in my highlights.
